subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should OpenClaw support any Trim OS-specific Gateway auth/pairing recovery or loopback exception in core, or should this issue stay limited to diagnostics and the existing device approval/auth model?
rationale: The reporter's desired outcomes include auth-bypass and package config behavior, but the source evidence shows this is an auth boundary and the Trim OS package owner is not established in this checkout.

options.title: Keep auth strict and request Trim OS proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Gateway protocol logs, connect-frame details, and package version data before changing core auth behavior.

options.title: Design a supported package recovery path
options.body: If maintainers own the Trim OS package surface, define a narrow package/doctor repair that respects current Gateway auth semantics.

options.title: Add a loopback bypass or config mode
options.body: This could unblock the reported deployment but would intentionally expand a sensitive Gateway auth surface and needs explicit security ownership.

recommendation.title: Keep auth strict and request Trim OS proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Gateway protocol logs, connect-frame details, and package version data before changing core auth behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Gateway client/package behavior and product/security scope, and steipete has strong history on the gateway-client package and device CLI approval surface.
